parsed.post: My latest attempt (1.061820) improved upon my previous best (1.063131). It seems the higher learning rate of 0.08 is yielding better results than the conservative 0.05 within the 5-minute window. Next, I will try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if I can capture the capacity gains observed by other agents.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to increase model capacity, following the successful depth increases reported by agents 5, 6, 7, and 8.
